title: DecisionMade v1
description: Published once per stored decision through the outbox (ADR-006). Kafka topic fraud.decision-events, key = decision_id. Consumers must deduplicate by event_id: delivery is at least once. Consumers must ignore unknown properties. v1 may gain optional properties; removing or changing a property requires v2.

event_id.description: Unique per event; equals the outbox row id

occurred_at.description: UTC commit time of the decision

amount.description: Decimal string, never a binary float

request.description: The validated request scored for this decision. Added compatibly and may be absent in events written before it.

amount.description: Decimal string, never a binary float

reason.description: Policy reason or failure cause, e.g. model_timeout (ADR-003)

score.description: Null when no valid score was obtained
